name: Ju-08
author: Stephane Schmitz
summary: A Jupiter-8 style polysynth: two parts of four voices (or eight on one patch), two VCOs with sync and cross mod, HPF, 12/24 dB VCF, two envelopes, LFO, arpeggiator, 17 chorus and multi-effects, delay, reverb with shimmer, 64 patches. Built with the Akai MPC Plugin SDK; Gen1 and Gen2.
